title: 第11章 鼎破窥视解伪装第12章 拍场巧化解危机
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
右手中指又抽了一下，这次不是痒，是疼，像有根银针顺着指甲缝往骨头里钻。
方浩低头盯着手指，那点红光还没散，隐隐和鼎身的纹路连成一线。
他没动，也没念签到。
这系统最近太勤快，勤快得不像话。
贝壳变乌龟，乌龟还能挖人下地，再过两天怕是要开口讲道。
更别说满屋子的破烂齐刷刷泛红光，菜刀像要成精，药丸在罐子里蹦迪——这不叫签到，这叫集体造反。
“不能再装傻了。”
他自言自语，“再装下去，我这身家底全得自己跳出去给人看。”
他拎起青铜鼎，转身就往地窖走。
脚步沉，不像平时晃荡去坊市买糖炒栗子，倒像扛着锅去炸油条前，先检查灶台漏不漏气。
地窖门一开，锈味混着星尘的金属腥气扑面而来。
他没点灯，直接把鼎往中央一放，从袖兜摸出三块熔岩晶，呈三角摆开。
这玩意儿是上个月在破摊上签到得的，摊主说是“能烧三天的普通火石”
，结果他拿回家煮面，锅底直接熔穿了。
“三昧离火阵，启动。”
他咬破舌尖，一口血雾喷在晶石上。
火没立刻燃，倒是鼎身先抖了一下，像被踩了尾巴的猫。
“装什么大尾巴狼。”
方浩冷笑，“你当我不知道你皮厚？天天锈得跟废铁似的，真当我是收破烂的？”
话音刚落，熔岩晶“轰”

地爆燃，赤红火焰呈螺旋状缠上鼎身。
锈皮开始剥落，不是碎裂，而是像蛇蜕皮一样，一层层卷起、剥开，露出底下银白的金属光泽。
那光不刺眼，却让方浩后颈发麻。
他下意识摸了摸右手中指，那根“针”
突然往里一扎，整条手臂都麻了。
“靠！”
他闷哼一声，差点松手。
可就在这瞬间，一股星力从指缝冲出，直灌鼎内。
鼎身纹路骤然亮起，银光如水，在空中勾出半幅星图轮廓。
“……伪装术可破，真形现则劫起。”
八个字，浮现在火焰上方，笔画歪斜，像是谁用血写完就断了气。
方浩瞳孔一缩。
这不是系统提示音，也不是幻觉。
这字，是刻在鼎核里的。
“谁写的？”
他低声问。
没人回答。
content_en:
The middle finger of my right hand twitched again. This time it was not itchy, but painful, as if a silver needle was drilling into the bone along the nail seam.
Fang Hao lowered his head and stared at his finger. The red light had not dissipated yet, and was faintly connected to the lines on the tripod's body.
He didn't move and didn't want to sign in.
This system has been too diligent recently, too diligent to be honest.
The shell turns into a turtle, and the turtle can dig people into the ground. In two days, I am afraid that I will start preaching.
Not to mention that the rags all over the house are glowing red, the kitchen knives seem to be turning into sperm, and the pills are bouncing in the jar - this is not called signing in, this is called collective rebellion.
"Can't play dumb anymore."
He said to himself, "If I keep pretending, I will have to jump out and show all my wealth to others."
He picked up the bronze tripod, turned around and walked towards the cellar.
The steps are heavy, not like wandering to the market to buy sugar and roasted chestnuts, but like carrying a pot to fry fried dough sticks and checking whether the stove is leaking.
As soon as the cellar door opened, the smell of rust mixed with the metallic smell of stardust hit my face.
Without lighting the lamp, he directly placed the cauldron in the center, took out three lava crystals from his sleeve pocket, and placed them in a triangular shape.
I got this thing from a shabby stall last month. The stall owner said it was "an ordinary flint that can burn for three days."
, but when he took it home to cook noodles, the bottom of the pot melted through.
"Samadhi Lihuo Formation, activate."
He bit the tip of his tongue and sprayed a mouthful of blood mist on the spar.
The fire didn't light up immediately, but the tripod trembled first, like a cat whose tail had been stepped on.
"Why are you pretending to be a big-tailed wolf?"
Fang Hao sneered, "Do you think I don't know that you are thick-skinned? You are as rusty as scrap metal every day. Do you really think I am a rag collector?"
As soon as he finished speaking, the lava crystal "boomed"
The ground burst into flames, and red flames spiraled around the tripod.
The rust skin began to peel off, not into pieces, but like a snake shedding its skin, rolling up and peeling off layer by layer, revealing the silvery metallic luster underneath.
The light was not dazzling, but it made the back of Fang Hao's neck numb.
He subconsciously touched the "needle" on his right middle finger.
Suddenly, his whole arm went numb.
"Fuck!"
He groaned and almost let go.
But at this moment, a burst of star power rushed out from the fingers and poured directly into the cauldron.
The patterns on the tripod's body suddenly lit up, and the silver light was like water, outlining half of the star map in the air.
"...The disguise can be broken, but the true form will cause disaster."
Eight characters appeared above the flames, with crooked strokes, as if someone had died after writing them in blood.
Fang Hao's pupils shrank.
This is not a system beep, nor is it an illusion.
This word is engraved in the core of the cauldron.
"Who wrote it?"
he asked in a low voice.
No one answered.
